title: Sugarloaf Mountain Vineyard
specs: 22 acres of vines with French vinifera clones grafted on American rootstock
Award-winning vintages reflecting precision and passion in winemaking
Covered heated patio for year-round vineyard experience
No reservations needed for tastings and flights
Tours require reservation by email, schedule a few weeks in advance
Dogs must remain outside and on leash at all times
Large group visits should call ahead to accommodate
Private parties and events available after business hours

includes: Free winery tours for small groups by reservation
blurb: Guests can enjoy tastings and flights of wine, with tastings available on weekends and flights available daily. Free tours of the winery are offered for small groups by reservation. The vineyard also hosts private parties and special events in and around the tasting room and patio, and offers a private vineyard house for rent.
extraNote: No reservations except for tours and large group visits · Outdoor bars closed on weekdays and over winter · No alcohol other than their wine permitted on property · Smoking not allowed anywhere on property · Parking lot opens at noon daily for winery patrons only · Closed only on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas
